rationale: All five edge-case/acceptance candidates were verified against src-tauri/src/commands/cmdlog.rs and dismissed: unbounded in-memory growth and the u64 id-wraparound are an accepted non-goal / a practically-unreachable edge case for this slice, the empty-command-string gap is a trivial cosmetic nit, and the two acceptance 'partial' rows (the added order field, and mod.rs's alphabetical placement) are non-defective spec-sketch deviations the lens itself confirms are correct in practice. Two checks (cargo test, cargo build/clippy) remain pending-stage-7 evidence, and standards review does not apply to the compact profile. 5 findings dismissed, 0 deferred, 0 blocking.

business_review.item: CmdRecord fields match spec (id, command, start_time, exit_code, duration_ms, raw_output)
business_review.notes: cmdlog.rs:28-36 matches spec's struct exactly.

business_review.item: chrono reused as existing dependency, no new timestamp crate added
business_review.notes: Cargo.toml only adds serde feature to existing chrono dep; no new crate.

business_review.item: cmdlog_open creates record with Utc::now(), empty output, None exit_code/duration_ms, returns id
cmdlog_append appends chunk; errors on unknown id or already-closed record
cmdlog_close sets exit_code, computes duration_ms saturating at 0, errors on unknown/already-closed
cmdlog_list returns all records in insertion order, no filter/sort options
business_review.notes: Walks a separate order: Vec<String> to preserve insertion order since HashMap does not.

business_review.item: cmdlog_get returns Ok(None) for unknown id, Ok(Some(record)) otherwise
All five commands are #[tauri::command] free functions returning CmdResult<T>
business_review.notes: Uses existing InstallerError-based CmdResult alias.

business_review.item: AppState gains cmdlog: Mutex<CmdLogStore> field
business_review.notes: state.rs:41; AppState constructed via ..AppState::default() in lib.rs.

business_review.item: CmdLogStore shape matches spec: records/next_id only
business_review.notes: Adds undocumented order: Vec<String> field, needed for insertion-order listing; behavior is correct.

business_review.item: Id generation: incrementing u64 counter formatted cmd-{n}, no uuid dependency
business_review.notes: cmdlog.rs:47-48; no new crate added.

business_review.item: pub mod cmdlog; added to commands/mod.rs in module-declaration order
business_review.notes: Placed alphabetically per the file's real convention; spec's literal 'after logger' text appears inaccurate.

business_review.item: cmdlog::* commands added to generate_handler! immediately after logger::* entries
Inline tests cover lifecycle, construction, not-found, append-after-close, double-close, overlapping opens
business_review.notes: cmdlog.rs:147-232; all six spec scenarios present plus an insertion-order test.

business_review.item: cargo test passes for the new module and does not regress existing suites
business_review.notes: Requires Stage 7 evidence; not verifiable from static diff review alone.

business_review.item: cargo build/clippy succeed with the chrono serde feature addition
business_review.notes: Requires an actual build/lint run; Cargo.lock not shown updated in the diff.

business_review.item: No frontend wiring added (ui/runner-bridge.js untouched)
business_review.notes: changed_files contains no ui/* paths.

business_review.item: No persistence to disk; purely in-memory store
business_review.notes: CmdLogStore only holds in-memory HashMap/Vec fields, no file I/O.

business_review.item: No retention/eviction/max-record-count policy in this slice
business_review.notes: Confirmed absent by design; store grows unbounded for the session, as the spec allows for this slice.

business_review.item: No filtering/search/sorting/pagination on cmdlog_list
business_review.notes: list() takes no parameters and returns the full insertion-ordered set.

business_review.item: No correlation with the existing nextId(prefix) client-side scheme
business_review.notes: Server-side id independently generated as cmd-{n}, opaque to callers.

business_review.item: No changes to logger.rs's flat debug log
business_review.notes: logger.rs is not part of the diff.
